title: AI Security Research Lab screen: let AI invent new Nuclei templates, scripts, and test ideas from CVEs and findings
goal: Create a dedicated 'Research' screen (accessible from the BUILD section of the sidebar) that exposes AegisPT's AI-driven capability creation. This is the screen where AI 'invents' new security tests. The screen has three panels: (1) CVE → Template Generator: Operator selects a CVE from the threat intel library, clicks 'Generate Detection Template'. The system calls cve_template_generator.py which uses ChatGPT OAuth to produce a detection-only Nuclei YAML. The result is shown with a diff-style preview. Operator reviews and submits to Pack Forge for approval/deployment. (2) Custom Script Ideas: The operator describes a target scenario in plain language (e.g. 'Check if MQTT broker allows anonymous subscribe on port 1883'). AI generates a Nuclei YAML or Python detection script, validated against the same safety rules. Stored in Custom CVE Library or Pack Forge staging. (3) Research Proposals: A read-only log of all AI-generated templates and ideas, with status (draft/staged/deployed/rejected) and the reasoning that led to each. This exposes what the AI system is 'thinking' — it shows its research output. Implementation: Wire up the existing cve_template_generator.py API endpoint (/api/v1/threat-intel/{id}/generate-nuclei-template) to a clear UI flow. The Custom Script Ideas panel uses a new endpoint POST /api/v1/ai/research/generate-script that calls the same ChatGPT OAuth provider with a custom system prompt.
scope: Code audit 2026-05-03: cve_template_generator.py is 421 lines, fully implementing AI-driven Nuclei template generation with safety validation (blocked protocols, banned payloads, GET/HEAD only). The API endpoint exists. The UI provides no clear entry point or workflow for this capability. Operators cannot 'ask AI to invent a new test'.
generation_reason: 421-line CVE template generator with full safety validation exists but has no accessible UI workflow — operators cannot use AI to create new tests.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Wire existing cve_template_generator.py to UI. The custom script panel needs only a POST endpoint that uses the same generator logic with operator-provided description. Do not change safety validation or Pack Forge approval gates.

success_criteria: A 'Research' screen is accessible from sidebar under BUILD section.
Operator can select a CVE and click 'Generate Template' — result appears in preview within 30s.
Generated template shows YAML preview with safety summary.
Operator can submit template to Pack Forge for review.
Custom script idea input allows plain-language description and returns detection script.
Research Proposals log shows all generated templates with status.
No regression in threat intel and pack E2E tests.
must_not_touch: Existing CVE feed or Custom CVE Library

acceptance_criteria: CVE template generation flow works end-to-end.
Generated templates go to Pack Forge staging.
